rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the structure built across a river or other flowing body of water.

example.english: This dam can control the water flow.
example.traditional: 呢個水壩可以控制水流。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 seoi2 baa3 ho2 ji5 hung3 zai3 seoi2 lau4

rows.note: Use this for the reservoir or body of stored water behind a dam, not for the barrier itself.

example.english: The reservoir behind the dam is especially full this year.
example.traditional: 今年水塘入面啲水特別多。
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 seoi2 tong4 jap6 min6 di1 seoi2 dak6 bit6 do1
